headword: {見返|みかえ}りを{求|もと}める
gloss: to expect something in return; to seek a reward

definitions.gloss: to expect something in return; to seek a reward or favor back
definitions.explanation: To do something while expecting a benefit, favor, or compensation in return. {見返|みかえ}り means a return favor or reward.

examples.japanese: {見返|みかえ}りを{求|もと}めない。
examples.english: to not expect anything in return.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{見返|みかえ}りを{求|もと}めて⟦{手伝|てつだ}った→手伝う：00898_tetsudau⟧ようだ。
examples.english: It seems he helped expecting something in return.

examples.japanese: ⟦{本当|ほんとう}→本当：00779_hontou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{親切|しんせつ}→親切：01144_shinsetsu⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、{見返|みかえ}りを{求|もと}めず⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{助|たす}ける→助ける：00895_tasukeru⟧ことだ。
examples.english: True kindness means helping people without expecting anything in return.

notes:
⟦{見返|みかえ}り→見返り：11064_mikaeri⟧ (a return, recompense) + ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{求|もと}める→求める：02316_motomeru⟧ (to seek). Describes acting out of self-interest, expecting a favor, payment, or advantage back. It is often used in the negative — {見返|みかえ}りを{求|もと}めない praises selfless behavior.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {見返|みかえ}りを{求|もと}めず⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧: without expecting anything in return
- ⟦{見返|みかえ}り→見返り：11064_mikaeri⟧⟦として→として：06802_toshite⟧: in return for

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{見返|みかえ}り→見返り：11064_mikaeri⟧: a return favor, compensation — the noun on its own
- ⟦{報酬|ほうしゅう}→報酬：12094_houshuu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{求|もと}める→求める：02316_motomeru⟧: to seek payment — specifically a monetary reward
